observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang walong card, naihihiwalay ang exposure sa diagnosis at naiuugnay ang pag-iwas sa tamang daan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains all eight cards, distinguishes exposure from diagnosis and links prevention to the route.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagbibigay ng diagnosis mula sa hitsura o ipinapalagay na lahat ng mikrobyo ay dumaraan sa parehong paraan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Diagnoses from appearance or assumes every germ spreads in the same way.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang walong pag-uugnay; walang bansag o diagnosis at may angkop na kontrol nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches all eight cards appropriately, without labels or diagnosis, and suggests suitable controls without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Karamihan ay tama pero kailangang linawin ang contact at paglanghap; naitatama matapos ang feedback.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Most matches are appropriate, but contact and inhalation need clarification; corrects them after feedback.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagbibigay ng diagnosis mula sa hitsura o ipinapalagay na lahat ng mikrobyo ay dumaraan sa parehong paraan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Diagnoses from appearance or assumes every germ spreads in the same way.
